name: FMR RESOURCES LIMITED
summary: FMR Resources Limited, an Australian company dating from 2003 and based in South Perth, explores for and develops battery and critical minerals, chiefly copper and rare earths in Canada. Its projects include the wholly owned Fairfield copper project of about 93.6 square kilometers in New Brunswick, a roughly 12 square kilometer project at Fintry in Ontario, and the Llahuin Project.
